title: Refactor data-schema core around inspectable schema objects
author: mjackson
body_preview: ## Summary  Refactor `@remix-run/data-schema` so built-in schemas are plain objects we can inspect. Put the data that describes each rule on the schema object itself. Validators should read that data from the object instead of hiding it in a closure.  The schema object should be the one source of truth for validation and for tools that need to inspect a schema. title: `on` mixin handler runs twice in "nested" `clientEntry` components
author: okalil
body_preview: ### Reproduction steps 1. Run https://github.com/okalil/remix-3-beta-bugs/tree/main/on-mixin-runs-twice 2. Click the first button, see 'click' logged once. 3. Click the second button, see 'click' logged twice.  ### Expected behavior On click the second button `'click'` is also logged once.  ### Actual behavior On click the second button `'click'` is logged twice.
